3. A defensive pivot/support - Corviknight (Defog, Roost) or Toxapex

- It likely plays defensively, sets up hazards, uses status moves
- It might use Toxic, Stealth Rock, etc.
- It probably switches to keep pressure on

- Physical sweeper (Garchomp)
- Special sweeper (Hydreigon)
- Defensive pivot with utility (Corviknight)
